verdict.rationale: This product is a state government business-registry and tax-registration agency. User-configurable autonomous background automations for AI-native workflows fall outside what this kind of service offers, so the axis is a category error. The documented text/email alert subscriptions for record changes and filing reminders are passive notifications, not user-built automations, so they do not show the capability ships.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
